mistakes.stem: Consider the following statements about the sample river:

teach: Every river in the sample land collects water from smaller streams on its way to the sea. These streams are its tributaries, so a sample river without one does not exist.
The north river rises in the north hills and drains into the west sea. The south river rises on the south plain and drains into the east sea. Both gather tributaries along the way.

mistakes.stem: Which sample city is the capital of the sample state?

teach: Gamma is the capital of the sample state. Beta is its largest port, which is why the two are easy to mix up.
The sample state moved its government to Gamma long ago, because Gamma sits in the middle of the state.

mistakes.stem: Which sample instrument measures sample pressure?

teach: The barosample measures sample pressure. The sampleometer only counts samples, so its name is a trap.
